description:
Add document scanning, OCR text recognition, data extraction and PDF creation to your .NET MAUI app. Runs 100% offline on device - no cloud, no data leaves the phone. Ready-to-use scanner UI with automatic edge detection, perspective correction and image filters for Android and iOS.

Includes:
- Document Scanner: automatic edge detection, perspective correction, image filters, page editing
- OCR: text recognition on device, no network access
- Data Extraction: read address, IBAN, amount, date, invoice fields and more
- Photo Payment: extract payment data and GiroCode from an invoice
- PDF Creation: searchable PDFs, JPG export, page size and file size control

A trial license key is available free of charge at https://sdk.docutain.com/TrialLicense
title: Docutain SDK for .NET MAUI
